title: Production Learning & Autonomous Roadmap Renewal IV
purpose: Compare verified released first-use capabilities 391–404 with a dated, read-only Production evidence-presence sample; renew the release queue without claiming unobserved outcomes.

review_basis.source: Read-only aggregate counts from the existing YW Supabase Production database on 2026-10-16, following Build 404 production deployment.
review_basis.scope: Six named canonical Production tables. One 90-day client-created_at count. No row-level identities, notes, contact data, site addresses or device data were retrieved.
review_basis.limitations: These six inspected tables are not the complete database or a business activity census. Counts and created_at presence do not prove success, failure, performance change, revenue, or that unrelated sources contain no work. Snapshot may become stale.
review_basis.privacy: Aggregate counts only; no customer, staff, property or job identity.
review_basis.denominator_boundary: Build 404 minimum 10 first-use customers; each conversion requires at least 10 at its own denominator plus current complete authorized source reads.

production_source_snapshot.measurement: All-time count in six named operational tables; 90-day count only for clients
production_source_snapshot.warning: No controlled user acceptance or customer trial was conducted; zero rows are recorded only for the inspected tables at this observation.

renewed_queue.title: First-Customer Intake Receipt & Duplicate-Safe Review
renewed_queue.source_authority: CRM customer intake and existing duplicate review
renewed_queue.acceptance: Demonstrate permissioned first-customer intake receipt and existing duplicate review on a real operator-provided example; withhold status when no dated customer record exists.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No automatic customer creation, duplicate merge, or broad-profile disclosure.

renewed_queue.title: Property & Four-Season Coverage Evidence
renewed_queue.source_authority: CRM properties, site intelligence and seasonal agreements
renewed_queue.acceptance: Reconcile one real customer-owned property to its seasonal work types without inferring winter or summer readiness from missing agreements.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No site mutation, enrollment or plan renewal without operator action.

renewed_queue.title: Estimate Acceptance to First Work Order Trace
renewed_queue.acceptance: Show explicit customer acceptance, internal approval and first work-order identity with missing approvals marked unavailable.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No automatic estimate acceptance, pricing or work-order issuance.

renewed_queue.title: First-Dispatch Schedule Receipt
renewed_queue.acceptance: Match an authorized first work order to a dated noncancelled schedule; show unresolved resource/workability exceptions separately.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No unattended dispatch, weather override or staff assignment.

renewed_queue.title: Production Start and Return-Visit Proof
renewed_queue.source_authority: Production sessions and field capture receipts
renewed_queue.acceptance: Reconcile first-job scheduled visit to an actual dated started session, partial completion and return-visit evidence.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No synthetic session or automatic completion.

renewed_queue.title: Material and Equipment First-Job Trace
renewed_queue.source_authority: Materials issue, equipment use and Production evidence
renewed_queue.acceptance: Distinguish recorded actual materials/equipment from estimates on the same first-job identity with caps and permission checks.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No inventory correction, lockout override or job-cost posting.

renewed_queue.title: Quality-Control Closeout Evidence
renewed_queue.source_authority: QC, supervisor signoff and closeout packages
renewed_queue.acceptance: Show first-job QC, supervisor approval and customer-safe proof completeness without substituting planned steps for completed evidence.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No automatic signoff, customer message or review request.

renewed_queue.title: Invoice Readiness and Candidate Provenance
renewed_queue.source_authority: Approved closeout and Finance invoice candidate source
renewed_queue.acceptance: Link approved first-job closeout to Finance candidate identity with explicit missing and approval states.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No posting an invoice, collection, payment or external provider call.

renewed_queue.title: First Invoice Receivable Confidence
renewed_queue.source_authority: Finance receivable and payment application views
renewed_queue.acceptance: Verify actual non-void first invoice presence and the authoritative receivable state only for permissioned, complete samples.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No charge, receipt allocation or customer follow-up automation.

renewed_queue.title: Seasonal First-Use Cohort Coverage
renewed_queue.source_authority: CRM first-use dates, seasonal services and Workability
renewed_queue.acceptance: Show season-specific first-use denominators only when dated, fully linked and sample-supported.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No performance attribution, staff ranking or zero assumption.

renewed_queue.title: Owner First-Use Trial Acceptance Workbench
renewed_queue.source_authority: Existing owner source checks, Help and operator acceptance
renewed_queue.acceptance: Provide a bounded owner acceptance checklist for each canonical first-use handoff and record unresolved evidence gaps without fake demo success.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No unattended seed data, external outreach, or account-role change.

renewed_queue.title: Production Learning & Autonomous Roadmap Renewal V
renewed_queue.source_authority: Dated production cohort evidence and release records
renewed_queue.acceptance: Review actual comparable first-job outcomes, withhold claims when denominators are inadequate, and renew another bounded queue.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No autonomous business transactions or unauthorized data access.

authority_boundary: Planning/review only. No schema, RPC, permissions, roles, Finance posting, provider calls, customer messages or external authorization grants.
